scopeNote: Transport for Wales Valley Lines (six commuter routes, 81 stations) is EXCLUDED from this catalog. TfW has no confirmed public GTFS static or GTFS-RT feed of any kind (report lines 9, 33, 66-80; confidence 'not found'). This is a distinct blocker from the National Rail account-level block below — there is no account to unblock, no token to wire; the feed itself does not appear to exist publicly. An outreach draft (docs/outreach-drafts/south-wales.md, Viv) has been prepared asking TfW to confirm GTFS/GTFS-RT availability, but no reply is recorded as of this pack. If TfW confirms a feed, Valley Lines needs its own follow-up oracle report and D1 pack pass, not a retrofit into this file. See jim-handoff.md.
notes: D1 oracle is docs/south-wales-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/south-wales/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.

This catalog covers National Rail through-running only. Cardiff Central is a shared physical hub with Valley Lines (separate infrastructure, footbridge connect per report line 19), but Valley Lines itself has no entry here — see scopeNote.

National Rail has NO static GTFS feed used to build this catalog (a Transitland GTFS dump exists per the oracle report and is listed above for reference/license purposes only) — Darwin is the intended live path once unblocked, same open product question as West of England (Darwin-only vs. GTFS base layer) is NOT raised here because a GTFS dump does exist for National Rail in this report, unlike West of England's report.

Hub lock: Cardiff Central (CDF). Shared hub with Valley Lines on separate infrastructure — proposed doNotGroup between the two agencies' boards at this station if Valley Lines ever ships; not built (no Valley Lines board exists to group against). See hazard-pack.md H6.

Severn Tunnel Junction (STJ) is a through-running-only boundary point per this report (line 20, C2/C3 point 5). West of England's merged pack instead names Chepstow (CPW) as its boundary station toward South Wales — a DISCREPANCY, not resolved in this pack. Both stations stay through-running-only (not merge points) at D1; flagged for Jim/Tim to reconcile at D2. See hazard-pack.md doNotGroup proposals.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region / East Midlands / North East / West of England.

No 'lines' array is provided for National Rail — no printed route/line map to transcribe, same as every National Rail-only region packed so far. This is a flat station list (hub, through-running-only).

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments for Darwin. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. National Rail static GTFS (Transitland) is CC-BY-2.0 UK, confidence 'clear', but is reference-only per above.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Cardiff Central is the sole hub lock (report C2/C3 point 2: 'Not Cardiff Queen Street, not Cardiff Bay, not Pontypridd'). Shared with Valley Lines on separate infrastructure (proposed doNotGroup, not built — see hazard-pack.md H6).

coverageGaps: National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists.

Transport for Wales Valley Lines: NO CONFIRMED PUBLIC FEED OF ANY KIND. Not an account-level block — no static GTFS, no GTFS-RT, no public API found. TransXChange-format timetables available only via direct contact (data@tfw.wales). Confidence 'not found' throughout the oracle report's TfW license section. Outreach draft prepared (docs/outreach-drafts/south-wales.md) but no reply recorded. Excluded from this catalog entirely — see scopeNote.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here.

National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe — no 'lines' array is provided, only the hub/through-running station list. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead.
Severn Tunnel Junction (STJ) vs. Chepstow (CPW) boundary discrepancy with West of England's merged pack — NOT reconciled in this pack. Flagged for D2. See hazard-pack.md.

81-station Valley Lines list is Wikipedia-sourced and explicitly marked unverified against an official TfW operator map in the oracle report (report line 29) — even if a feed later appears, that station list needs independent verification, not a straight import from the oracle report's prose.

nationalRailStations.note: No printed route/line map exists for National Rail in the oracle report — Darwin is a per-station real-time board, not a fixed-route product. This is a flat station list, not a 'lines' array. BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN.
